steps.caption: sync: both losses read the batch's own old_logprobs
overlap on: GRPO adds a π_prox snapshot pass
max_lag = 2: the third epoch reads three versions

notices.claim: In sync mode the GRPO and P3O lanes have the same shape: one training block per epoch.
Turning overlap on inserts a purple π_prox snapshot block before each GRPO training block; the P3O lane gains no block.
At max_lag = 2 the third rollout block feeds a buffer of three versions (v0…v2); the new epoch repeats the same pattern, a π_prox pass plus decoupled training for GRPO and Eq. 12 alone for P3O.
